statement: Every Delaware corporation must maintain a registered office and registered agent in the State (8 Del. C. §§ 131-132); the agent is changed by board resolution with a certificate certifying the change filed under 8 Del. C. § 133, and the Division of Corporations fee schedule prices the domestic 'Change of Agent/Office' filing at $50 (revised August 1, 2026).
caveat: The $50 figure is the state filing fee for a one-page domestic certificate; certified copies, expedite tiers, and the foreign-corporation change filing carry their own fee lines, and commercial agents charge their own service fees on top. Fee schedules are revised — check the live schedule before filing. This repo does not file the change.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state process variants wave 2026-10-22); independent domain expert review pending
